name: Smart
overview: Scripture reveals that true wisdom and knowledge begin with the fear of the LORD, as Proverbs 1:7 teaches, contrasting the wise who restrain their speech with fools who lack discretion (Proverbs 29:11). From the creation of the heavens and earth by God (Genesis 1:1) to the formation of man with life breathed into him (Genesis 2:7), God's sovereign design underscores that genuine understanding is rooted in Him. The topic of being 'smart' also cautions against prideful display of intellect, encouraging humility and reliance on God's guidance rather than self-exaltation.
